Turn spending records into a checked review and upcoming-payments list with AI.

[Start this course on AILesson](https://ailesson.io/courses/review-bills-and-subscriptions-with-ai)

A bank list tells you that money moved. It does not always tell you what a charge was for, whether a refund belongs to an earlier purchase, or what will happen next month. A neat AI summary can hide those differences unless you give it a task you can check.

In this Course, you review one month of practice spending records and saved bill notices. You ask AI to organize the rows, keep the connection to the originals, and separate supported explanations from open questions. Then you inspect the evidence behind its labels and build an upcoming-payments list that leaves uncertain charges visible.

You will work through one connected task:

- **Give AI a checkable task.** Choose the useful material and request an organized table you can trace back to individual records.
- **Check classifications against the records.** Use receipts and notices to correct labels, connect refunds, and keep a possible duplicate unresolved when the evidence stops there.
- **Build the next-action list.** Ask AI to distinguish scheduled payments from follow-up questions and check the handoff before using it.

AI handles the repeated sorting and calculation. You decide what the records support, what needs another source, and what action to take. The same approach works for an expense claim, an order history, or another collection of records with unclear labels.

## Frequently asked questions

### Do I need to connect a bank account or share my own bills?

No. The Course supplies synthetic records with no real personal or company data, and you work through guided requests and prepared excerpts from recorded AI exchanges. The exercises do not send messages to a live AI. You can complete them without connecting an account or sharing live financial information.

### Do I need accounting or spreadsheet skills?

No. You inspect a small set of records and practise how to ask and check. AI performs the arithmetic; separately checked totals are provided so you can focus on whether the result includes the right records and preserves uncertainty.

### Will this pay bills or decide which subscriptions to cancel?

No. You finish with a reviewed list of scheduled payments and specific follow-up questions. Payment, cancellation, and resolving unrecognized charges remain actions for the account owner outside the Course.
